title: Dimension of the ambient space
statement: Let $p$ be a prime and $\bbf_p$ the field with $p$ elements, and for a natural number $n$ set $V = \bbf_p^n \times \bbf_p^n$. Then $V$ is a vector space over $\bbf_p$ of dimension \[ \dim_{\bbf_p}(V) = 2n. \]
hypotheses_covered: V is the space of pairs of coordinate vectors over F_p
